scenario: A Global Administrator is phished and the attacker signs in through a legacy authentication client that never sees the MFA prompt, then changes tenant settings
threat_source: External attacker using credential phishing or password spray
affected_assets: Entra tenant configuration; every workload behind it
treatment: Block legacy authentication, require phishing-resistant authentication strength for administrator roles, convert standing roles to eligible PIM assignments, and add risk-based sign-in and user policies; verify with sign-in log tests for each protocol

scenario: A Conditional Access change or an MFA service disruption locks out every administrator and no emergency account can sign in
threat_source: Internal configuration error or identity service outage
affected_assets: Tenant administration and every dependent recovery step
treatment: Maintain two cloud-only emergency accounts with passkeys excluded from blocking policies, alert on their use, drill them at least quarterly, and pilot access changes in report-only mode with a tested rollback

scenario: A guest from a counterparty keeps access to a deal Teams channel and its SharePoint files after the transaction closes
affected_assets: Deal workspace, term sheets, models and correspondence
treatment: Give every guest a sponsor and end date, set site-level guest expiry, run periodic access reviews or a documented sponsor review, and test that removal revokes access at the resource

scenario: A user consents to a third-party productivity app that reads mail and files, and the app is later abused or breached
threat_source: Malicious or compromised third-party application; consent phishing
affected_assets: Mailboxes, OneDrive content and Microsoft Graph data
treatment: Restrict user consent to verified publishers and low-impact permissions, enable the admin consent request workflow, and recertify granted permissions and owners quarterly

scenario: Confidential files are opened and cached on an unmanaged or lost personal device
threat_source: Device theft or malware on an unmanaged endpoint
affected_assets: SharePoint and OneDrive confidential content; cached mail
treatment: Require Intune compliance with encryption for sensitive workloads, treat devices without a compliance policy as not compliant, and encrypt the highest confidentiality label so cached copies stay protected

scenario: A Copilot prompt summarizes a document that was shared with Everyone except external users years ago
threat_source: Internal user, curious or malicious, using AI grounding over overshared content
affected_assets: HR, finance and deal documents on overshared sites
treatment: Run data access governance reports, remediate broad permissions, apply container labels, exclude highly confidential labels from Copilot processing with a DLP policy, and repeat a synthetic prompt test after remediation

scenario: An attacker spoofs the firm's domain to send changed wire instructions to an investor because DMARC is not enforced
threat_source: External attacker conducting business email compromise
affected_assets: Brand domain reputation, investor relationships and funds in transit
treatment: Complete the sender inventory and SPF record, enable DKIM for every sending domain, move DMARC from monitoring to reject in stages while reviewing aggregate reports; lookalike domains remain a residual exposure

scenario: A staff member clicks a link in email or Teams that was clean at delivery and weaponized afterwards
treatment: Assign the Standard preset security policy, confirm Safe Links time-of-click protection in email, Teams and Office apps for the licensed population, and use risk-based policies to contain a compromised session

scenario: A SharePoint site is encrypted by ransomware or bulk deleted and no measured restore exists
threat_source: Ransomware, malicious insider or accidental deletion
affected_assets: SharePoint and OneDrive content, versions and permissions
treatment: Select a recovery method with agreed recovery objectives, protect the critical sites, run a measured restore that checks content and permissions, and stop treating retention as a backup

scenario: An investigation cannot reconstruct a compromised account's activity because the sign-in and audit records expired
threat_source: Any incident combined with a monitoring control failure
affected_assets: Entra sign-in and audit logs; Purview unified audit log
treatment: Route Entra logs to a workspace or storage for the approved retention, verify Purview audit retention and per-user licensing, and prove retrieval with a synthetic event

scenario: A deletion rule in a retention policy purges deal records that are under hold or needed for a regulator request
affected_assets: Exchange and SharePoint records subject to a records schedule or hold
treatment: Adopt an approved records schedule, review the principles of retention and any holds before rollout, stage the policy on a pilot scope, and keep a records-owner approval for each deletion rule

scenario: New hires and contractors sit in a population without Conditional Access entitlement, so MFA and device requirements never apply to them
affected_assets: Accounts outside the protected population and everything they can reach
treatment: Map each access feature to its entitlement and population, keep security defaults or a Microsoft-managed policy set as the floor for unlicensed populations, and review the map at each onboarding wave
